title: Formal vs informal
description: Switch register confidently according to audience and purpose.

introduction.headline: Choose the right register
introduction.body: Compare formal and informal wording and practise converting between them.
introduction.bodyIt: Confronta formulazioni formali e informali e pratica a convertirle.

vocabulary.example: Email to clients requires a more formal register.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Le email ai clienti richiedono un registro più formale.

vocabulary.example: Colloquial phrases can feel too casual in reports.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Le espressioni colloquiali possono sembrare troppo informali nei report.
La corrispondenza commerciale spesso evita le contrazioni.

options: I should be grateful if you could confirm.
exercises.answer: I should be grateful if you could confirm.
exercises.explanation: Grateful if you could is a classic formal request pattern.

exercises.promptIt: Completa: Business ____ often avoids contractions and slang.
exercises.explanation: Correspondence means written communication, especially professional email or letters.

review.tip: Take one casual message and rewrite it for a senior stakeholder.
